summary: Jennifer Kellogg of St. Joseph, Missouri, and her 21-year-old daughter Alexandra summited Maroon Peak then North Maroon Peak; on descent Alexandra followed the wrong route and became stuck unable to climb up or down, and Jennifer became stranded on a rocky ledge in Lost Remuda Basin; 20 Mountain Rescue Aspen members responded with a HAATS UH-60 Blackhawk; Alexandra was found uninjured at the Gun Site and flown from the rock glacier, Jennifer was evacuated by mechanical uphaul to the west ridge and flown out in darkness; all out of the field by 10:30 p.m.
location: North Maroon Peak, west side / Lost Remuda Basin
notes: INSERT run1000; source is a forum repost of the full Pitkin County Sheriff's Office press release 'Climbers Rescued From North Maroon Peak' (Deputy Grant Jahnke, Incident Commander), dated 7/21/2014, parent-opened live and matched exactly.
